traditions.WLC: כִּי שָׁ֖ם בֵּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: étenim quóniam ibi benedíxerant Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: for there they blessed the LORD :

26.english_reference: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֡ן קָֽרְא֞וּ אֶת שֵׁ֨ם הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ ה֛וּא עֵ֥מֶק בְּרָכָ֖ה
traditions.VUL: vocavérunt locum illum Vallis benedictiónis
traditions.KJV: therefore the name of the same place was called , The valley of Berachah ,

traditions.WLC: עַד הַ יּֽוֹם
traditions.VUL: usque in præséntem diem .
traditions.KJV: unto this day .

27.english_reference: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יָּשֻׁבוּ כָּל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וִֽ יהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט בְּ רֹאשָׁ֔ ם
traditions.VUL: Reversúsque est omnis vir Iuda , et habitatóres Ierúsalem , et Iósaphat ante eos
traditions.KJV: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them ,

27.english_reference: to go again to Jerusalem with joy

traditions.WLC: לָ שׁ֥וּב אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ שִׂמְחָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: in Ierúsalem cum lætítia magna ,
traditions.KJV: to go again to Jerusalem with joy ;

27.english_reference: for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שִׂמְּחָ֥ ם יְהוָ֖ה מֵֽ אוֹיְבֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: eo quod dedísset eis Dóminus gáudium de inimícis suis .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies .

28.english_reference: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּ נְבָלִ֥ים וּ בְ כִנֹּר֖וֹת וּ בַ חֲצֹצְר֑וֹת

traditions.KJV: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets

28.english_reference: unto the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: אֶל בֵּ֖ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: in domum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: unto the house of the LORD .

29.english_reference: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of [ those ] countries

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ פַּ֣חַד אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל כָּל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ אֲרָצ֑וֹת
traditions.VUL: Irruit autem pavor Dómini super univérsa regna terrárum ,
traditions.KJV: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of [ those ] countries ,

29.english_reference: when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel

traditions.WLC: בְּ שָׁמְעָ֕ ם כִּ֚י נִלְחַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עִ֖ם אוֹיְבֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: cum audíssent quod pugnásset Dóminus contra inimícos Israel .
traditions.KJV: when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel .

30.english_reference: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּשְׁקֹ֖ט מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט
traditions.VUL: Quievítque regnum Iósaphat ,
traditions.KJV: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet :

30.english_reference: for his God gave him rest round about

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֧נַֽח ל֦ וֹ אֱלֹהָ֖י ו מִ סָּבִֽיב
traditions.VUL: et prǽbuit ei Deus pacem per circúitum .
traditions.KJV: for his God gave him rest round about .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט עַל יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Regnávit ígitur Iósaphat super Iudam ,
traditions.KJV: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah : [

31.english_reference: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים֩ וְ חָמֵ֨שׁ שָׁנָ֜ה בְּ מָלְכ֗ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et erat trigínta quinque annórum cum regnáre cœpísset :
traditions.KJV: he was ] thirty and five years old when he began to reign ,

31.english_reference: and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.VUL: vigínti autem et quinque annis regnávit in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem .

31.english_reference: And his mother ’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ עֲזוּבָ֖ה בַּת שִׁלְחִֽי
traditions.VUL: et nomen matris eius Azuba fília Sélahi .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .

32.english_reference: And he walked in the way of Asa his father

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ דֶ֛רֶךְ אָבִ֥י ו אָסָ֖א
traditions.VUL: Et ambulávit in via patris sui Asa ,
traditions.KJV: And he walked in the way of Asa his father ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֑ נָּה
traditions.VUL: nec declinávit ab ea ,
traditions.KJV: and departed not from it ,

32.english_reference: doing right in the sight of the LORD

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: fáciens quæ plácita erant coram Dómino .
traditions.KJV: doing [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD .

33.english_reference: Howbeit the high places were not taken away

traditions.WLC: אַ֥ךְ הַ בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen excélsa non ábstulit ,
traditions.KJV: Howbeit the high places were not taken away :

33.english_reference: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers

traditions.WLC: וְ ע֤וֹד הָ עָם֙ לֹא הֵכִ֣ינוּ לְבָבָ֔ ם לֵ אלֹהֵ֖י אֲבֹתֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et adhuc pópulus non diréxerat cor suum ad Dóminum Deum patrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers .

34.english_reference: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , first and last

traditions.WLC: וְ יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הָ רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ הָ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Réliqua autem gestórum Iósaphat priórum et novissimórum
traditions.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , first and last ,

34.english_reference: behold , they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani

traditions.WLC: הִנָּ֣ ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בְּ דִבְרֵי֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן חֲנָ֔נִי
traditions.VUL: scripta sunt in verbis Iehu fílii Hánani ,
traditions.KJV: behold , they [ are ] written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani ,

34.english_reference: who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֹֽעֲלָ֔ה עַל סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: quæ digéssit in Libros regum Israel .
traditions.KJV: who [ is ] mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel .

35.english_reference: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אֶתְחַבַּר֙ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲחַזְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: Post hæc íniit amicítias Iósaphat rex Iuda cum Ochozía rege Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: ה֖וּא הִרְשִׁ֥יעַ לַ עֲשֽׂוֹת
traditions.VUL: cuius ópera fuérunt impiíssima .
traditions.KJV: who did very wickedly :

36.english_reference: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחַבְּרֵ֣ הוּ עִמּ֔ וֹ לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֳנִיּ֖וֹת לָ לֶ֣כֶת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ
traditions.VUL: Et párticeps fuit , ut fácerent naves , quæ irent in Tharsis :
traditions.KJV: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֳנִיּ֖וֹת בְּ עֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר
traditions.VUL: fecerúntque classem in Asióngaber .
traditions.KJV: and they made the ships in Eziongeber .

37.english_reference: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְנַבֵּ֞א אֱלִיעֶ֤זֶר בֶּן דֹּדָוָ֨הוּ֙ מִ מָּ֣רֵשָׁ֔ה עַל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.VUL: Prophetávit autem Eliézer fílius Dodau de Marésa ad Iósaphat , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat , saying ,

37.english_reference: Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah , the LORD hath broken thy works

traditions.WLC: כְּ הִֽתְחַבֶּרְ ךָ֣ עִם אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ פָּרַ֤ץ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽת מַעֲשֶׂ֔י ךָ

traditions.KJV: Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah , the LORD hath broken thy works .

37.english_reference: And the ships were broken , that they were not able to go to Tarshish

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשָּׁבְר֣וּ אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְ לֹ֥א עָצְר֖וּ לָ לֶ֥כֶת אֶל תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ
traditions.VUL: contritǽque sunt naves , nec potuérunt ire in Tharsis .
traditions.KJV: And the ships were broken , that they were not able to go to Tarshish .
